summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Banc of America Merrill Lynch Commercial Mortgage Inc., as depositor, on behalf of Morgan Stanley Bank of America Merrill Lynch Trust 2026-C36. It reports the issuance of a commercial mortgage pass-through certificates series under a pooling and servicing agreement dated as of August 1, 2026. The trust's assets include 31 fixed-rate mortgage loans secured by 57 properties, with one loan being part of a pari passu whole loan structure. The filing merely discloses a definitive agreement for a standard ABS issuance. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary securitization transaction update. No deal terms typical of special situations were stated, and no strategic event or corporate action is involved.
